errors.text: The hypothesis predicts a predominantly BCC structure and treats lack of BCC dominance as falsifying, whereas the target result is predominantly FCC: approximately 83% FCC and 17% BCC.

The initial state conflates nominally equimolar elemental feedstock powders with the cast-alloy baseline and incorrectly assigns cast-like porosity and coarse-grained segregation to the starting powder mixture.
Low-load Vickers testing alone cannot isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening; controlled grain-size or precipitation-state comparisons are required.
